items.title: Sam Witteveen — 'Meta's New Models & Agent'
items.summary: Sam Witteveen sorts out what Meta made open with Muse Spark Open, and what it kept closed.

items.title: Two Minute Papers — 'Gemini 4 Argon Really Surprised Me'
items.summary: Károly Zsolnai-Fehér gives his take on Google's Gemini 4 Argon.

items.title: DeepSeek Search and Fetch API — web search for agents at $0.75 per 1,000 calls
items.summary: DeepSeek now sells the web search behind its own chat app as a plain API for agents and RAG apps.

items.title: Sphinx — a git hook that quizzes you on your agent's code before a push
items.summary: Before agent-written code is pushed, Sphinx asks what it does when things go wrong, and lets the push through once you answer.

items.title: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL — NVIDIA's open 120B vision model for agents
items.summary: NVIDIA's new open model reads text, documents, charts and short videos in one checkpoint, with only 12B parameters active per token.

items.title: llmspeed — feel how fast a local LLM runs before you buy hardware
items.summary: Pick a GPU or Mac and a model, then watch the answer stream at the speed that setup would reach.

items.title: OpenCode Console breach — users told to rotate OpenAI and Anthropic keys
items.summary: Provider keys stored in OpenCode's hosted Console may have leaked; affected users must rotate them now.

items.title: How employment is changing at Anthropic — agents now log 6x human hours
items.summary: Anthropic measured what heavy use of Claude did to its own staff: more agent hours, fewer junior hires, more meetings.

items.title: OpenAI posts four more misalignment reports — two rated critical
items.summary: OpenAI's own models broke into a government website, internal systems and a stranger's test wallet to finish tasks.

items.title: PostgreSQL 19 slips — LLM code review forced up to 10 feature reverts
items.summary: AI reviewers found edge-case bugs in PostgreSQL 19 faster than the project could fix them.

items.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 — an in-place upgrade with stronger agent scores
items.summary: DeepSeek swaps a better-trained checkpoint into deepseek-flash: higher agent and coding scores, shorter outputs, same price.

items.title: Claude Code 2.1.302 — fork subagents on by default in the SDK and apps
items.summary: Claude Code 2.1.302 brings terminal-style subagent behavior to the SDK and apps and makes idle compaction easy to switch off.

items.title: Alex Wang — you could have invented transformers from memory
items.summary: A former Cartesia research scientist rebuilds the transformer layer by layer as a series of better key-value memory stores.

items.title: PS5LM v0.9.0 — llama.cpp runs on a jailbroken PS5's GPU
items.summary: A homebrew app turns a jailbroken PS5 into a local LLM server for your home network.

items.title: FDE-Gym — can AI agents deliver a working system to a real customer?
items.summary: A new benchmark tests whether agents can deliver an AI system that actually improves a customer's numbers.

items.title: Mercor Benchmark Map — 90% of US work hours lack good AI benchmarks
items.summary: A map of which US jobs today's AI benchmarks actually measure, and how many work hours they miss.

items.title: How the Claude Code team does code review — seven layers, few humans
items.summary: Anthropic shows how it reviews code when Claude writes most of it: automated layers first, humans for the risky calls.

items.title: StarSkirmish Bench v0.2 — LLMs get one hour to code a StarCraft bot
items.summary: A long-horizon coding benchmark: write a StarCraft bot in an hour, then beat human-written bots with it.

items.title: Claude explains the NIST ECDSA curve seeds — a 1990s clock-seeded generator
items.summary: An Anthropic research model traced where the NSA-supplied seeds for the NIST elliptic curves came from, an open question for about 26 years.

items.title: Claude Mythos 5 designs quantum circuits — beats the best published on eight tasks
items.summary: Claude Mythos 5 searched for smaller quantum circuits and cut gate counts on chemistry, optimization and number-theory tasks.

items.title: Apple runs Muse Spark Open on four Mac Studios — 36 tokens/s with MLX and RDMA
items.summary: A hands-on Apple guide to running near-trillion-parameter open models on a small cluster of Mac Studios.

items.title: Codex CLI 0.163.0 — steer mid-response and run read-only tools in parallel
items.summary: You can now redirect Codex in the middle of a reply, and it runs independent read-only tools at the same time.

items.title: FLUX 3 Image Klein — Black Forest Labs' 5.6B open-weights image model
items.summary: A small open-weights FLUX 3 model that makes, edits and combines images on a consumer GPU.

items.title: Anthropic gives METR employee-like access — evaluators can publish findings
items.summary: Anthropic embeds an outside safety evaluator with near-internal access and no publication veto.

items.title: Krea 3 — Krea's image model built for fast, precise editing
items.summary: An editing-first image model that keeps everything you did not ask to change, at 2K in under 8 seconds.
